newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin has heavy cold, no link to heart surgery.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin has heavy cold, no link to heart surgery.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin has "a heavy cold" and a high temperature, a Kremlin spokesman said on Monday, but added that the illness had no relation to the 65-year-old Kremlin leader's recent heart surgery.
Press secretary Sergei Yastrzhembsky told a Kremlin briefing that a number of meetings planned for Yeltsin in the coming days had been postponed because he was unwell.

Yastrzhembsky said Yeltsin had conducted two meetings on Monday -- one on relations with NATO and one separately with Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin -- "despite a heavy cold and high temperature" of 37.5 centigrade in the morning.
"In this connection a number of meetings scheduled for the coming days have been postponed," he said. Yastrzhembsky did not make clear if Yeltsin was still in his Kremlin office.
RIA news agency said a council of doctors, including the head of the Kremlin medical centre Sergei Mironov, was meeting at Yeltsin's country residence to review the president's cold.
Yeltsin had a quintuple heart bypass operation on November 5 and returned to work at the end of last year.
